market_summary: Broad US dollar strength and risk-off sentiment dominate the London session, driving EURUSD, GBPUSD, US100, and BTCUSD into steep intraday breakdowns below session VWAPs and Value Area Lows. However, current prices across all assets are severely stretched at or beyond their -2 ATR lower envelopes approaching key structural support levels without fresh RVOL > 2.0 climax confirmation, favoring patient HOLD stances over chasing late-stage momentum into potential liquidity traps ahead of the NY session.

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10793, VAH 1.10983) and below POC 1.10943, currently breaking below VAL via live price 1.10784. CVD is NEUTRAL (-321) with a sharp negative slope (-4838), showing incoming seller pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades below both VWAP (1.10866) and EMA50 (1.10892). ATR channel is expanding with price touching the lower ATR band (1.1078). RVOL is 1.184 (no yellow spike yet on signal bar). Previous low at 1.10824 has been breached; however, being right at VAL without RVOL > 2.0 breakout confirmation warrants caution against chasing extended downside directly above Session Low 1.10662.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / price below declining VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below Prev Low 1.10824 toward VAL

signals.rationale: Price traded inside Value Area on the signal bar but live price (1.32536) flushes below VAL (1.32611) and well below POC (1.32738). CVD is BEARISH (-4072) with negative slope (-593), aligning with downside pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is firmly below VWAP (1.32670) and EMA50 (1.32692). The forming candle pierces through the lower ATR band (1.32555). RVOL on signal bar was 1.07 (normal volume), lacking climax breakout confirmation. With price hovering just above major Session Low support at 1.32500 without a clean retest or yellow volume confirmation, risk of a bounce/liquidity sweep is elevated.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / price below downward-sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: breakdown below VAL 1.32611 toward Session Low 1.32500

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (28086.57) and far below POC (28117.21). CVD is BEARISH (-4.10) with negative slope (-0.69), agreeing with the strong sell-off. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Trend is strongly bearish relative to VWAP (28131.81) and EMA50 (28153.17). Price is heavily stretched beyond the lower ATR band (28032.29), printing live at 27938.31. RVOL is 0.961 (consistent with Dukascopy US100 index tick volume behavior). Crucial Session Low (28030.00) was broken. However, live price is severely overextended ~100 points beneath the -2 ATR band prior to the NY open without a consolidation base.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / aggressive flush below VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (73295.04) and well below POC (73518.45). CVD is BEARISH (-0.06) with negative slope (-0.01), confirming persistent short flow. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is under heavy distribution below VWAP (73484.26) and EMA50 (73408.67). ATR channel is expanding with price trading far beneath the lower ATR band (72721.93) at live 72465.70. RVOL was 1.247 on the signal candle (no yellow >2.0 spike). Session Low at 72639.70 has been violated, but the forming candle has a deep wick to 72155.80 and is heavily stretched into extreme oversold territory away from the 20 EMA baseline, making continuation shorting hazardous.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / steep downtrend below VWAP and EMA50
